global_higher_order_constraints.rule: For shared work or memoization,match actual ordered row/value/parameter/config/position/state generations and compatible numeric contracts. A source atom union,shape,pointer or candidate name is not a same-invocation identity proof.

Interfaces and useful work touched by multiple candidates are charged once in the selected transformed graph. F05/F09 quant, F06/F17/F33 input/projection, F08/F11/F19 KV and F14/F15/F16 output surfaces are explicit examples.
Retain every original round/reduction/tie/NaN/scale/RNG/error effect unless a declared equivalence proof permits changing it. Real algebra or final BF16 dtype alone does not prove IEEE equality.

Choose one consistent representation/partition/publication schedule at each interface. Full versus sharded weights,early projection versus raw gather,fused attention versus split continuation,direct cache versus COW/recompute,and row-worker versus expert migration are alternative domains,not additive gains.

Union all read and write effects,including pending writers,captured/native/aux/host observers,rollback and future cache readers. Preserve every producer-ready and final-retirement edge;no whole-operator barrier unless necessary.

All target/draft/layer/iteration instances share actual finite pools. Current24Cube/48Vector per exposed device,paired-card/TP/EP cuts and AICPU-sharing caveats apply globally;host capacity is a separate symbolic resource.

Necessary transformed work and genuine capacity uppers yield lower bounds. Combine independent resources by max;accumulate only proved nonduplicate necessary work on the same resource. Do not invert a feasible schedule,fastest measurement or rated reference into a physical universal upper.

Re-derive required information per card/owner after fusion/repartition/replication. Possible forwarding/reuse prevents blind sum of rank-pair traffic or TP/EP cuts;prove disjoint necessary bytes before a shared-ingress sum.

Cross-iteration edges carry an iteration offset and accepted/proposal/state generation. Prefetch depending on a new Markov proposal waits for that ID or pays speculation;A alone cannot release a proposal-dependent prefetch.

Hierarchical macro/children are one work population. M19 or fullattention/MoE parents must not be added to their already counted primitive children. The source templates are interfaces and alternative branches,not simultaneous launches.

Do not mix v164PMU times with v168receiver work,old166host timings with current171 causal savings,or missing/ambiguous observations with zero work. Current positive config labels narrow only their exact source conditions.

Every registered35+7family is routed here. This does not prove all possiblemodel/sourcevariants or all implementations enumerated;that requires an independent source/graph/obligation audit rather than a pair count or a finished report.

decisions.analysis: Routed and shared quantizers have different reviewed FP16/TRUNC/INT8 rounding contracts. Sharing a BF16 source load or a public producer scan is distinct from reusing the same INT8 values/scales. The selected conservative graph retains QR and QS; no credit for deleting one quantizer.
decisions.guards: Same source value/generation and valid-row prefix for any shared scan; exact original reductions,rounds,zeros/nonfinite and all readers preserved. Target padded816 and shared800 cannot be equated by name.

decisions.analysis: E is already fused. Its source-conditioned receiver assignments determine GMM work; local sender zero does not remove remote expert demand. Within-expert row scheduling and whole-expert redistribution are alternative domains.
decisions.guards: Keep clipped/kept assignment identities,source scales,top-k contribution order,peer flags/finalize/unpermute and private event/state semantics. Existing zero-M skip and tile utilization are baseline.

decisions.analysis: Do not add a whole-expert rank-balance proxy,within-expert row-worker proxy and V2 pad-trim credit as independent speedups. Cross-card redistribution changes weight residency and messages; prior325extra fullweight-pair example costs>=10.71167GiB across16devices/40layers,not per device and not a latency prediction.
decisions.guards: Use the chosen one schedule and its actual physical24Cube/48Vector pools; source inner40 fields and declared48rowworkers are not independent physical machines.

decisions.analysis: Combined E/SE/J may avoid an intermediate only once. Preserve current shared scaling/alpha,HC coefficient/residual banks,raw/normalized auxiliary/KV/head readers and numeric accumulation order.
decisions.guards: An ordinary successful fusion candidate is conditional on its exact observer contract; missing private native buffer operands do not prove an interface dead.

decisions.analysis: A public BF16 argmax replacement can preserve score banks and other observers. A stronger ID-only path needs raw/processed/logprob/entropy/confidence/processor/RNG demands reconciled; do not make that stronger guard a prerequisite for the narrower public replacement.
decisions.guards: Tie,NaN/Inf,index width,INT32-to-INT64 interface and all pre-return checks retained. No post-return random/recovery savings credited to a valid all-greedy branch.

decisions.analysis: HC/normalization sharing or precomputation across layers is conditional on coefficient/value/parameter keys and consumer tile readiness; no whole-layer serial barrier is inserted merely by choosing a particular tile.
decisions.guards: Cube work and Vector/communication tasks share finite pools. Earlier start/late join/observed gap is not measured slack or extra free capacity.

decisions.analysis: PF can begin only with an exact known next-use key or explicitly paid speculation. Rollback/accepted-prefix state,positions,slots and parameter epochs decide reuse. Wrong-path prefetch is extra work and live memory,not free overlap.
decisions.guards: Retire all queued writers and readers before storage reuse; address/shape/count equality is not value identity. Preserve old visible generations and error/RNG/state effects.

decisions.analysis: The reviewed repeated hidden.float conversion can share an unchanged pre-rotation FP32 fork under its domain,charging240KiB extended live storage per active invocation. Do not use the rotated value as the original residual; do not multiply live cost by every layer without actual overlapping lifetimes.
decisions.guards: Same source/generation and numeric round; host/UVA lookup keys and selected ID content remain distinct. Whole embedding weight bytes are not demanded HBM traffic.

resource_ledger.physical_pools: For each of16 exposed current compute devices:24Cube,48Vector. Eight cards pair two exposed devices; TP8 occupies four cards. AICPU per-device6 has shared-SMP ambiguity,not16 independent six-core pools.
resource_ledger.necessary_work: Count each required transformed node/edge once AFTER the selected legal representation/algorithm. Retained distinct QR/QS are both work; removed intermediates are not automatic removed useful MACs.
resource_ledger.Cube_cycle_lower_bound: For each device, L_cycles>=max_mode(Q_necessary_MAC_mode/(24*r_mode)),with current r_INT8=8192,r_BF16/FP16=4096 and separately declared FLOAT modes. This is a mode-wise bound; summing mode times requires an additional exclusive-issue/shared-budget proof.
resource_ledger.physical_time_lower_bound: L>=max_d,mode(Q_d,mode/(24*r_mode*f_upper_d)),with physical f_upper unknown. Rated1800MHz instantiates only a labelled reference,not a physical time bound.
resource_ledger.Vector_and_special: Add each necessary typed Vector/sort/index/resource constraint as a lower bound with a genuine matching capacity upper. Missing rates stay symbolic; a measured fastest sample is not an upper capacity.
resource_ledger.network: Use ownership/information cut for required raw payload and initial replicas. Single-owner full TP8/four-card AllGather gives6S/card24Saggregate ingress. EP and TP share card/link budgets when proved; HCCS_SW is not an independent full-bandwidth lane.
resource_ledger.joint_network_combination: Without a proof of necessary disjoint bytes on one shared ingress, use max(L_TP,L_EP),not an unexamined sum of their cuts. If a payload can be retained/forwarded/reused,derive the joint necessary information first.
resource_ledger.memory: B_necessary depends on storage initial state,residency,capacity and transformed output demands. Parameter/workspace size or trace traffic is not an unconditional HBM floor.
resource_ledger.time_combination: Take max of whole-window necessary resource bounds and proven release/dependency cuts; do not add overlappable producer/collective/Cube/Vector minima or invert a feasible schedule as a throughput upper.
resource_ledger.capacity_feasibility: At every physical device/time,live parameters+old and new banks+queued reader/writer lifetimes+prefetch/speculation+workspace must fit actually available memory. Total exposed global memory is not free memory; no live-peak credit from independently nonoverlapping diagrams.
resource_ledger.performance_comparison: The v172 counter rank and the v170 receiver-work/time cohort remain separate. Do not divide one population work by another population time,add per-candidate ideal gains,or call a reference bound an attainable speedup.
